_about: AI-infrastructure supply-chain layers, upstream-ordered. Each metric is normalised to [0,1], higher = tighter. Metric levels are CURATED ESTIMATES informed by public company commentary and industry reporting (see provenance) — directional, not precise measurements. Tagged 'curated' accordingly. Replace with measured figures where available.
provenance: Curated from public earnings commentary and industry reporting (e.g. TSMC CoWoS capacity commentary; HBM 'sold out' commentary from SK Hynix/Micron; grid transformer & turbine lead-time reporting; copper mine development timelines; uranium supply commentary). 2024-2025 vintage.

layers.name: GPUs / AI accelerators
layers.note: Demand-driving layer; supply gated by the layers beneath it (packaging, HBM).

layers.name: HBM memory
layers.note: HBM capacity reported effectively sold out across the cycle; 3-supplier oligopoly.

layers.name: Advanced packaging (CoWoS)
layers.note: The widely-cited binding constraint: CoWoS capacity additions lag accelerator demand.

layers.name: Leading-edge foundry
layers.note: Sub-5nm wafer capacity; new fabs take years and tens of billions of capex.

layers.name: Power & grid
layers.note: Grid interconnection queues + multi-year lead times for transformers and turbines.

layers.name: Copper
layers.note: Electrification + datacenter demand vs. ~10yr+ greenfield mine development.

layers.name: Uranium / nuclear fuel
layers.note: Datacenter power appetite reviving nuclear; primary supply slow to restart.

capital_flow._note: Illustrative directional capex/investment intensity by layer ($bn-scale index), showing capital migrating upstream as each constraint binds. Tagged 'illustrative' — not audited capex totals.
